building: 文脉·新中式殿堂级水院展馆复合体

coordinate_system.origin: 主殿入口大门正中 / 地面水平线 (0,0,0)
coordinate_system.axis: +X 东, +Y 殿内(北), -Y 桥引道(南), +Z 上

bbox.note: 导出网格在 Blender 世界坐标中的包围盒

lod.note: 单档 PBR，材质级合批；draw call 数 = 材质数

web3d.origin: 主殿入口大门正中地面水平线 = (0,0,0)，单位为米
web3d.uv_channel_0: UVMap —— albedo / normal / metallic-roughness 平铺贴图
web3d.uv_channel_1: UVMap2 —— lightmap_pack 非重叠布局，供 AO 使用
web3d.orm_packing: 单图 R=AO, G=Roughness, B=Metallic；occlusionTexture 指向同一 image、texCoord=1
web3d.camera_nodes: 5 个 Empty 随 GLB 导出，extras 含 look_at(Blender 坐标)/lens_mm/cn；Three.js: scene.getObjectByName('CAM_...')

css_safe_area.note: 五个机位构图已按此安全区留白；背景建议透明或 #0b111e→#161e2e 渐变叠加

coordinates: Blender metres Z-up; glTF converts to Y-up
notes: Nominal plinth footprint differs from full geometry bounds including eaves and dragon spouts.
Contact classes are review hints, not proof that intersections are harmless.
Craft motifs are original procedural interpretations, not authenticated historical reproductions.
Craft assemblies are integrated by parts13/crafts.py; independent props exports are not asserted by this manifest.
Requested dimensional and clearance tolerances require separate measurement evidence.
